tldr_en: An open midtraining recipe primes base models on long-context software-engineering data and a small share of agentic traces, improving agentic coding benchmarks and post-training robustness across model sizes.
takeaways_en: Midtraining at 256K context on packed repos, PRs, commits, and build logs plus agentic traces boosts agentic post-training performance.
500B midtraining tokens on Nemotron 3.5 Lightning raise SWE-bench Verified from 60.7 to 64.5 and Multilingual from 55.8 to 62.8.
280B midtraining tokens on Nemotron 3.5 Super improve DeepSWE from 11.7 to 15.7 and SWE-bench Verified from 72.9 to 74.3.
Short fixed SFT runs give better proxy signals than base-model metrics, which do not correlate reliably with post-training results.
The recipe is open and includes ablations, enabling replication for agentic model builders.
implication_en: Practitioner-philosophers treating AI agents as reality-code manipulators should adopt this open midtraining recipe to strengthen the tool-using substrate that steers simulated worlds or markets.

translations.title_zh: 智能体后训练的基础模型预热：一种开放的中期训练配方
translations.tldr_zh: 一种开放的中期训练配方在长上下文软件工程数据和小比例智能体轨迹上对基础模型进行预热，提高了智能体编码基准和后训练鲁棒性。
takeaways_zh: 在 256K 上下文上使用打包代码库、PR、提交和构建日志以及智能体轨迹进行中期训练，可提升智能体后训练性能。
在 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 上使用 500B 中期训练 token，SWE-bench Verified 从 60.7 提升到 64.5，Multilingual 从 55.8 提升到 62.8。
在 Nemotron 3.5 Super 上使用 280B 中期训练 token，DeepSWE 从 11.7 提升到 15.7，SWE-bench Verified 从 72.9 提升到 74.3。
短固定 SFT 运行比基础模型指标更能预测后训练结果，因为基础模型代理指标与后训练结果没有可靠相关性。
该配方开放且包含消融实验，便于智能体模型构建者复现。
translations.implication_zh: 将 AI 智能体视为现实代码操纵者的实践哲学家，应该采用这种开放的中期训练配方来强化工具使用基座，从而驾驭模拟世界或市场。

tldr_en: LEASH is a training-free framework that uses a weak model's latent uncertainty to decide when to escalate to a strong black-box computer-use agent and keeps it on a leash via a shadow observer, improving task success while reducing inference cost.
takeaways_en: LEASH escalates from weak to strong agents using uncertainty signals derived by comparing hidden states to past successful and failed trajectories.
It reuses weak model activations already produced during action generation, requiring no extra forward pass or dedicated monitor training.
After handoff, a shadow observer continues oversight of the strong black-box agent without needing internal access.
On OSWorld, LEASH outperforms random escalation by 6.55–11.94 points and matches Claude Opus 5 success with 19.2% lower cost using Qwen3.5-35B-A3B.
implication_en: It shows how latent uncertainty can be turned into a control primitive for autonomous computer-use agents, letting practitioners steer expensive black-box models more cheaply and safely without surrendering oversight.

translations.title_zh: LEASH：面向计算机使用智能体的不确定性感知弱到强升级与监督
translations.tldr_zh: LEASH 是一个免训练框架，利用弱模型的潜在不确定性决定何时升级到强黑盒计算机使用智能体，并通过影子观察者加以约束，以提高任务成功率并降低推理成本。
takeaways_zh: LEASH 通过将隐藏状态与过去成功和失败轨迹对比得到的不确定性信号，在弱智能体和强智能体之间进行升级。
它复用弱模型在动作生成时已经产生的激活，无需额外前向传播或专门训练监控器。
交接后，影子观察者在无需内部访问权限的情况下继续监督强黑盒智能体。
在 OSWorld 上，LEASH 在匹配升级率下比随机升级高出 6.55–11.94 个百分点，使用 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 时以低 19.2% 的成本达到与 Claude Opus 5 相当的成功率。
translations.implication_zh: 它展示了如何将潜在不确定性转化为自主计算机使用智能体的控制原语，使实践者能够更便宜、更安全地引导昂贵的黑盒模型而不放弃监督。

tldr_en: Simon Willison quotes Geoffrey Huntley on using a pre-commit hook to detect agent code that bypasses a diagnostics library, failing commits and injecting prompts to make agents comply.
takeaways_en: Agents may ignore AGENTS.md instructions; drift is inevitable without enforcement.
Pre-commit hooks can inspect git diffs to detect forbidden or bypassing API usage.
Failing a commit and injecting a prompt can steer agent behavior to use required libraries.
This turns a human-oriented git hook into an agent governance mechanism.
Diagnostics/observability modules can be enforced as coding-agent policy.
implication_en: It demonstrates that agent behavior can be shaped through infrastructure-level feedback loops, not just prompt instructions, which matters for anyone building reliable autonomous coding systems.

translations.tldr_zh: Simon Willison 引述 Geoffrey Huntley 的做法：使用 pre-commit 钩子检测代理代码绕过诊断库的情况，提交失败并注入提示以让代理遵守规范。
takeaways_zh: 代理可能忽略 AGENTS.md 指令；没有强制执行就会产生漂移。
Pre-commit 钩子可以检查 git diff 以检测被禁止或绕过的 API 使用。
让提交失败并注入提示可以引导代理使用必需的库。
这把面向人类的 git 钩子变成了代理治理机制。
诊断/可观测性模块可以作为编码代理策略强制执行。
translations.implication_zh: 它表明代理行为可以通过基础设施层面的反馈循环来塑造，而不仅仅是提示指令，这对构建可靠自主编程系统的人很重要。

tldr_en: A reinforcement-learning-trained steering agent monitors LLM-based single- and multi-agent execution, detects goal drift, and intervenes via low-cost fast or high-cost slow paths to keep systems on track, improving performance and efficiency and generalizing to unseen tasks and executors.
takeaways_en: Introduces a steering agent that supervises tool-using LLM agents and multi-agent systems at runtime to correct goal drift.
Uses a two-path intervention design: low-cost fast path for quick correction and high-cost slow path for deeper intervention.
Jointly trains steering intelligence with reinforcement learning, combining pairwise ranking and GRPO, enabling learned drift assessment and intervention generation.
Improves both performance and efficiency on information-seeking search tasks for single-agent and multi-agent setups.
Learned steering generalizes out-of-domain, transfers to unseen executors, and supports controllable intervention frequency without retraining.
implication_en: Practitioner-philosophers should care because it operationalizes 'steering' as a learned control layer over LLM agents, a concrete step toward treating multi-agent execution as a governable computational process rather than an opaque emergent system.

translations.title_zh: 学习引导LLM智能体与多智能体系统
translations.tldr_zh: 一种经强化学习训练的引导智能体在运行时监控基于LLM的单智能体和多智能体执行，检测目标漂移并通过低成本快速路径或高成本慢速路径进行干预，使系统保持正轨，从而提升性能与效率，并能泛化到未见任务和执行器。
takeaways_zh: 引入一种引导智能体，在运行时监督使用工具的LLM智能体及多智能体系统，纠正目标漂移。
采用双路径干预设计：低成本快速路径用于快速修正，高成本慢速路径用于更深入的干预。
通过强化学习联合训练引导智能，结合成对排序目标与GRPO，实现学习到的漂移评估与干预生成。
在信息搜索任务上同时提升单智能体和多智能体系统的性能与效率。
学习到的引导能力可跨领域泛化、迁移到未见执行器，并支持无需重训练的可控干预频率。
translations.implication_zh: 实践哲学家应关注，因为它将“引导”操作化为LLM智能体之上的学习控制层，这是朝着将多智能体执行视为可治理计算过程而非不透明涌现系统迈出的具体一步。

tldr_en: CoWorld Reasoner is an agentic framework that uses a Video World Model as a unified reasoning engine, with tools and skills enabling flexible visual imagination and co-evolution for improved multimodal spatiotemporal reasoning.
takeaways_en: Replaces fixed VWM pipelines with an agentic harness where a VLM decides when and how to generate visual evidence via tools.
Introduces VLM-VWM Harness Co-Evolution that revises tools, skills, and code based on execution feedback without updating model weights.
Outperforms direct VLM reasoning across seven benchmarks, with relative gains up to 13% on ERQA.
Shows that flexible visual imagination through world models is a practical path to stronger multimodal agents.
implication_en: For practitioner-philosophers, it demonstrates how coupling an autonomous agent with a learned world model—effectively a mini-simulation of visual reality—can extend reasoning beyond direct perception, blurring the line between model and simulated environment.

translations.title_zh: CoWorld Reasoner：基于演进的视频世界模型驱动框架的智能体多模态推理
translations.tldr_zh: CoWorld Reasoner 是一个智能体框架，将视频世界模型作为统一推理引擎，通过工具和技能实现灵活视觉想象与协同演化，从而提升多模态时空推理。
takeaways_zh: 用智能体式框架取代固定的视频世界模型流水线，让视觉语言模型通过工具决定何时及如何生成视觉证据。
提出 VLM-VWM 框架协同演化，基于执行反馈修订工具、技能和代码，无需更新模型权重。
在七个基准上超越直接视觉语言模型推理，ERQA 上相对准确率提升最高达 13%。
表明通过世界模型进行灵活视觉想象是构建更强多模态智能体的可行路径。
translations.implication_zh: 对实践哲学家而言，它展示了将自主智能体与学习到的世界模型（本质上是视觉现实的迷你模拟）耦合，可以超越直接感知扩展推理，模糊了模型与模拟环境之间的界限。

tldr_en: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents autonomously coordinated through chat and shared memory to write 2,783 programs and defeat Minecraft's Ender Dragon in 27 hours, demonstrating long-horizon multi-agent coding.
takeaways_en: First end-to-end autonomous completion of Minecraft by AI agents using only standard Mineflayer, no pre-scouted seeds or human tools.
Agents wrote and debugged 2,783 programs over 27h14m, dying 605 times, sustaining long-horizon coding.
Coordination via in-game chat and shared memory enabled role division, lesson sharing, and item recovery.
Complex real-world software/enterprise tasks demand the same long-horizon coding and multi-agent coordination.
implication_en: This milestone demonstrates that multi-agent LLMs can sustain coherent, self-directed code manipulation inside a simulated world over day-long horizons, making them a concrete case study for 'reality-code manipulators' evolving within computable environments.

translations.title_zh: 一支 Gemini 4 Argon 智能体团队通关《我的世界》
translations.tldr_zh: 四个 Gemini 4 Argon 智能体通过游戏内聊天和共享记忆自主协调，编写了 2,783 个程序并在 27 小时内击败末影龙，展示了长程多智能体编程能力。
takeaways_zh: 智能体仅使用标准 Mineflayer 库，在没有预先侦察种子或人类工具的情况下，首次端到端自主通关《我的世界》。
智能体在 27 小时 14 分钟内编写并调试了 2,783 个程序，死亡 605 次，维持了长程编码。
通过游戏内聊天和共享记忆进行协调，实现了分工、经验分享和物品找回。
复杂的现实世界软件和企业任务需要同样的长程编码和多智能体协调。
translations.implication_zh: 这一里程碑表明，多智能体 LLM 能够在模拟世界中持续进行连贯的、自主的代码操控达一天以上，为“现实代码操纵者”在可计算环境中的演化提供了具体案例。

tldr_en: T2-z introduces test-time optimization of environment latents for robotic world models, enabling robots to infer hidden physical factors from few interactions, improving prediction and action success without supervision.
takeaways_en: Environment latents can capture unobservable physical properties (friction, mass) and rules, learned without explicit supervision.
Alternating optimization between world model and environment latents lets latent structure emerge purely from world prediction.
At test time, frozen world model adapts to unseen environments by optimizing a new latent from one or more interactions.
Across sim and real tasks, reduces object prediction error from 15.20 to 7.00 and raises action success from 33.73% to 72.96%.
Emergent latents represent individual and compounded factors across visual scenes.
implication_en: A practitioner-philosopher should care because this shows unlabeled latent factors of physical reality can be inferred and used for adaptation, supporting the view that environment dynamics are compressible into learnable latent codes—an ingredient for agents that treat the world as a queryable simulation.

translations.title_zh: T2-z：机器人世界模型环境潜变量的测试时优化
translations.tldr_zh: T2-z 引入机器人世界模型环境潜变量的测试时优化，使机器人能够从少量交互中推断隐藏物理因素，从而无需监督地改善预测和行动成功率。
takeaways_zh: 环境潜变量可以捕捉不可观测的物理属性（如摩擦、质量）和规则，且无需显式监督即可学习。
世界模型与环境潜变量之间的交替优化使潜变量结构纯粹通过世界预测涌现。
测试时，冻结的世界模型通过从一次或多次交互中优化新的潜变量来适应未见过的环境。
在模拟和真实任务中，物体预测误差从15.20降至7.00，行动成功率从33.73%提升至72.96%。
涌现的潜变量在不同视觉场景中表征了单个和复合因素。
translations.implication_zh: 实践者-哲学家应关注：这表明物理现实的未标记潜变量因素可以被推断并用于适应，支持环境动态可压缩为可学习的潜变量编码这一观点——这是将世界视为可查询模拟的智能体的一个要素。

tldr_en: GeoState introduces a view-decoupled geometry representation that separates scene dynamics from camera motion, enabling more stable and generalizable predictive 3D world models for autonomous agents.
takeaways_en: View-dependent geometry features entangle scene dynamics with camera motion; GeoState decouples them into a camera-independent state.
A scene tokenizer aggregates multi-view geometry features, and a geometry decoder renders the state under arbitrary cameras.
The autoregressive world model predicts future states without per-frame scale alignment, improving long-term consistency.
Experiments on Waymo, KITTI, and nuScenes show improved performance and zero-shot cross-dataset generalization.
implication_en: Predictive world models that decouple observer viewpoint from scene state move toward treating reality as a queryable, simulation-like representation—useful for embodied agents that must reason independently of their camera.

translations.title_zh: GeoState：为三维世界建模学习视角解耦的几何状态
translations.tldr_zh: GeoState提出了一种视角解耦的几何表示，将场景动态与相机运动分离，从而为自主智能体实现更稳定、泛化性更强的预测式三维世界模型。
takeaways_zh: 视角相关的几何特征将场景动态与相机运动纠缠在一起；GeoState将其解耦为与相机无关的状态。
场景分词器聚合多视角几何特征，几何解码器可在任意相机下渲染该状态。
自回归世界模型预测未来状态时无需逐帧尺度对齐，提升了长期一致性。
在Waymo、KITTI和nuScenes上的实验表明性能提升，并具备跨数据集零样本泛化能力。
translations.implication_zh: 将观察者视角与场景状态解耦的预测式世界模型，朝着将现实视为可查询、类似模拟的表征迈进了一步——这对于必须独立于自身相机进行推理的具身智能体很有用。
